label: Green cover
description: Share of centre-crop pixels classed as vegetation (2G-R-B > 5).

label: Greenness (ExG)
description: Mean excess green 2g-r-b on chromatic coordinates, vegetation pixels.

label: Mean hue
description: Circular mean HSV hue of vegetation pixels; yellowing moves it down from ~100.

label: Brightness
description: Mean brightness of the whole centre crop (exposure check, not a trait).
